title: keckiella antirrhinoides
intro: Keckiella antirrhinoides, commonly known as Yellow or Orange Keckiella, is a perennial herb in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Keckiella antirrhinoides are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and phenolic glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
